questionText:
A square paper, shown in figure (I), is folded along the dotted lines as shown in the figures (II) and (III). Then a few cuts are made as shown in figure (IV). Which one of the following patterns will be obtained when the paper is unfolded?

Note: The figures shown are representative.
explanation:
Step 1: Analyze the folding process
1. The square paper is first folded diagonally along the top-left to bottom-right axis.
2. The resulting triangle is folded diagonally again to form a smaller triangle as shown in figure (III).

Step 2: Trace the cuts upon unfolding
1. Unfolding along the second fold reflects the shapes across the bisecting line.
2. Unfolding along the main diagonal fold reflects the entire pattern across the main diagonal to fill out the full square.

Step 3: Analyze the symmetry and orientations
- The triangular notch cut on the hypotenuse edge unfolds into small triangles pointing outwards along the edges.
- The cuts made inside the paper maintain symmetry across the folded axes.
- Reversing the folds step-by-step produces the exact layout shown in option (A).
